authentication_policy: Payload bodies only. No tokens, cookies, request headers or reusable authentication material are permitted.

endpoint_families.name: competitions
endpoint_families.intentionally_unsupported: CFS authentication/unpublished and match-stat lifecycle states do not apply to this public catalogue.

endpoint_families.name: competition_seasons
endpoint_families.intentionally_unsupported: CFS authentication/unpublished and match-stat lifecycle states do not apply to this public catalogue.

endpoint_families.name: rounds
endpoint_families.intentionally_unsupported: CFS authentication/unpublished and match-stat lifecycle states do not apply to this public catalogue.

endpoint_families.name: teams
endpoint_families.intentionally_unsupported: CFS authentication/unpublished and match-stat lifecycle states do not apply to this public catalogue.

endpoint_families.name: matches
endpoint_families.intentionally_unsupported: CFS authentication/unpublished states do not apply; live/concluded detail is retained in match records rather than player-stat arrays.

endpoint_families.name: match_detail
endpoint_families.intentionally_unsupported: Pagination does not apply to an identifier-addressed detail endpoint; CFS errors do not apply.

endpoint_families.name: player_id_map
endpoint_families.intentionally_unsupported: Pagination is not exposed by this endpoint; optional display fields and match lifecycle states do not exist in its scalar crosswalk.

endpoint_families.name: season_players
endpoint_families.intentionally_unsupported: Live/concluded match states do not apply. CFSSDS001 is classified at the shared CFS transport boundary.

endpoint_families.name: match_rosters
endpoint_families.intentionally_unsupported: Pagination metadata is not part of the verified round-roster response. HTTP 401 and CFSSDS001 use shared CFS error fixtures.

endpoint_families.name: match_player_statistics
endpoint_families.intentionally_unsupported: Pagination is not part of the verified match-scoped response. HTTP 401 and CFSSDS001 use shared CFS error fixtures.

endpoint_families.name: statspro_season_total
endpoint_families.intentionally_unsupported: Live polling and browser-captured credentials are intentionally unsupported.

endpoint_families.name: statspro_round_total
endpoint_families.intentionally_unsupported: Live polling and browser-captured credentials are intentionally unsupported.
